accepted.sentence: In kitchens, a pull-out waste bin can separate recycling from general rubbish while keeping containers out of sight.
Placed between work areas, a two-sided unit can divide a room while remaining accessible from either side.
A fitted enclosure can conceal plumbing beneath a sink while leaving doors available for routine repairs.
In workshops, wall-mounted compartments keep hand tools reachable above benches, preserving scarce work surface.
In commercial kitchens, separate locked compartments can keep cleaning chemicals apart from food-contact equipment and utensils.
At home, a lockable unit can keep passports and other important documents together but inaccessible to casual visitors.
A salon may use enclosed storage near styling stations to keep spare towels and hair products close at hand.
In museums, enclosed display spaces can limit visitors' direct contact with fragile objects while keeping them visible.
